title: Fine-tune your App Transport Security settings
description: Transport Layer Security (TLS) uses encryption to protect connections from prying eyes, and URLSession provides strong TLS connections by default with App Transport Security (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/information_property_list/nsapptransportsecurity) (ATS). If you need to connect to older servers that don't support TLS, however, you can now add ATS exceptions to your app.
